title: Whole blood RNA signatures in tuberculosis patients receiving H56:IC31 vaccine as adjunctive therapy
author: ALONSO-RODRIGUEZ, NOELIA
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Run high‑throughput microfluidic qPCR
steps.instruction: Measure expression of 183 immune‑related genes using 96.96 IFC chips on a Biomark HD system (Standard BioTools) following the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Set Ct detection threshold
steps.instruction: Consider any Ct value < 35 as the cut‑off for reliable detection.

steps.title: Calculate relative gene expression
steps.instruction: Determine ΔCt for each target gene using GAPDH as the reference gene.

steps.title: Correct batch effects
steps.instruction: Apply the ComBat function (R sva package version 3.48.0) with default parametric adjustment mode to GAPDH‑normalized expression data.

steps.title: Perform longitudinal differential expression analysis
steps.instruction: Compare i) H56:IC31 group versus Controls and ii) Responders versus Controls at all post‑vaccine time points from day 84 to day 238.

steps.title: Statistical testing with multiple‑test correction
steps.instruction: Use a non‑parametric Mann‑Whitney U‑test for each comparison and apply Benjamini‑Hochberg correction for multiple testing.

steps.title: Identify significant DEGs
steps.instruction: Declare genes as differentially expressed when the adjusted p‑value is < 0.05.
